notablePrerequisites:
Progenitor Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Progenitor Mimic do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Progenitor Mimic.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Progenitor Mimic.
Activate Progenitor Mimic by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
